evidence.source_assertion: SgrS represses ManXYZ synthesis through two manXYZ mRNA binding sites: the manX coding site and the manX-manY intergenic site independently control manX and manYZ translation. manZ is coupled to manY; both sites support efficient message degradation and full 2DG-stress recovery. This is not direct inhibition of assembled transport or an SgrT protein effect.

evidence.source_assertion: The ECOLI 27.0 MG1655 cAMP-bound complex explicitly contains protein complex PC00004 and compound CAMP. No component coefficient is supplied here; no bound-complex occupancy or numerical stoichiometry is inferred.
CAMP is an explicit component of the native cAMP-bound CRP complex; its component coefficient is absent. This records composition without asserting cAMP occupancy.
The exact ECOLI CAMP compound has a CHEBI58165 unification link and a charged InChI matching the issuing ChEBI compound. Its identity is distinct from any inferred binding occupancy.

The ECOLI 27.0 MG1655 CRP protein complex contains component PD00257 with coefficient 2. This establishes the protein homodimer, without inferring a cAMP coefficient for the separately named bound complex.
The exact ECOLI polypeptide PD00257 has a native UniProt P0ACJ8 unification link. Native MG1655 provenance and the reviewed K-12 UniProt sequence scope remain distinct.
